column5: F: 新建订单。选好产品,回调会填好其余内容。 | M: 工艺路线是肥料包装流程,物料清单是肥料七十号,批量二百。 | F: 数量一百,保存。 | M: 订单八万号,草稿状态,预留了一百。 | F: 可是你看,有两行父产品。 | M: 物料清单被展开了两次。真正的 Libero 是否如此,我们还没有定论,并且如实说明。 | F: 还有四行组件,每个父产品两行。 | M: 同一份物料清单,写了两遍。
column6: F: A new order for one hundred.
column7: F: A new order. We pick the product, and the callouts fill the rest. | M: The routing, Fertilizer Packing Process. The bill of materials, Fertilizer number seventy. Batch size, two hundred. | F: Quantity, one hundred. Save. | M: Order eighty thousand, drafted, with one hundred reserved. | F: But look. Two Parent Product rows. | M: The BOM was exploded twice. Whether a real Libero does that is still an open question for us, and we say so. | F: And four component lines, two for each parent. | M: Same bill, written twice.

column7: F: Complete. | M: Status completed, approved, and the one hundred stay reserved. | F: Fifteen cost rows were written. | M: The standard cost, snapshotted.

column5: F: 开工之前,先看产品信息。 | M: 肥料一万公斤在库,袋子五百个。 | F: 成品呢? | M: 零。 | F: 库存的成本是多少? | M: 标准价,每公斤二点五,每个袋子零点四。
column7: F: Before we make anything, Info Product. | M: Fertilizer in kilos, ten thousand on hand. Bags, five hundred. | F: And the finished product? | M: Zero. | F: What does the stock cost? | M: Standard price, two and a half a kilo. Zero point four a bag.

column7: F: Now we issue the components to the order. | M: One hundred bags, forty in cost. | F: And seven thousand and seventy kilos. | M: Cost: seventeen thousand six hundred seventy six. Two and a half a kilo.

column5: F: 回到产品信息。 | M: 肥料降到两千九百二十九公斤,袋子四百个。 | F: 库存跟着单据走。 | M: 少了一百个袋子,少了七千零七十公斤。
column7: F: Back to Info Product. | M: Kilos fell to two thousand nine hundred twenty nine. Bags, four hundred. | F: Stock follows the document. | M: Minus one hundred bags. Minus seven thousand seventy kilos.

column5: F: 现在收货。先四十,再六十。 | M: 每次收货承担相应的成本。 | F: 订单显示已交付一百,没有预留。 | M: 成品在库一百。 | F: 把两次收货加起来。 | M: 一万七千七百一十六,正好等于发料的成本。
column7: F: Now receipts. Forty first, then sixty. | M: Each receipt takes its share of the cost. | F: The order shows one hundred delivered. Nothing reserved. | M: And the finished product, one hundred on hand. | F: Add the two receipts. | M: Seventeen thousand seven hundred sixteen. Exactly what we issued.

column5: F: 成本收集器窗口。 | M: 四张单据,两次发料,两次收货。 | F: 四张都已完成。 | M: 每一张都是签名过的单据。
column7: F: The Cost Collector window. | M: Four documents. Two issues, two receipts. | F: All four completed. | M: Each one is a signed document.

column5: F: 如果物料清单无效呢? | M: 我们把订单日期定在物料清单生效之前,二零零七年。 | F: 被拒绝了,物料清单已过期。 | M: 什么都没有保存。之前十九张订单,之后还是十九张。 | F: 订单列表呢? | M: 还是十九张。日志写着,什么都没有封存。 | F: 是拒绝,不是保存一半。
column6: F: A bad order is refused.
column7: F: What if the BOM is not valid? | M: We date an order before the BOM begins, in two thousand seven. | F: Refused. Bill of materials expired. | M: Nothing was saved. Nineteen orders before, nineteen after. | F: And the order list? | M: The same nineteen. The log says nothing sealed. | F: A refusal, not a half save.
